digest.component_or_area: test suite performance / wiki render corpus caching
propositions: The process-local lru_cache on _rendered() causes each xdist worker to independently re-render all 178 corpus bodies (~884 pandoc spawns per worker), tripling cache-fill CPU under -n 3 --dist worksteal versus serial execution
The three test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical tests each recompute pass-1 renders that _rendered() already cached, duplicating ~50% of their runtime

A session-scoped digest-keyed artifact stored on disk and shared across xdist workers via tmp_path_factory.getbasetemp().parent eliminates per-worker cache fills while maintaining test coverage of all 178 corpus bodies

Sharding the artifact per stratum with PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER-rotated probe order prevents workers from queueing on the same shard, reducing cold-session wall time from full-corpus to single-stratum duration
Inter-process mutual exclusion via os.mkdir (atomic) with 150s fallback deadline ensures one compute per stratum per session, with loser fallback keeping tests under the 300s timeout guard
